inApp.welcomeBody: Before you start, set up the essentials below. <emph>Houston can't work without them.</emph> It takes 3 minutes.

connectAiIntro.title: Connect your AI
connectAiIntro.body: Your agents need an AI to work. I'll show you where to connect it.

connectAi.title: Pick the AI you already use.
connectAi.hint: Your agents will run on it
connectAi.already: You already have an AI connected.

integrationsIntro.title: Connect your apps
integrationsIntro.body: Your agents act through your apps, like email and calendar. I'll show you where.

connectIntegration.title: Connect your email.
connectIntegration.hint: Or any app you use every day
connectIntegration.already: You already have an app connected.

integrationConnected.title: App connected!
integrationConnected.body: That's how easy it is. Your agents can reach 1000+ apps this way.

createAgentIntro.title: Create your first agent
createAgentIntro.body: Agents are teammates that take work off your plate. I'll show you where to create one.

createAgent.title: Click New agent
createAgent.hint: Give it a name you like

agentCreated.title: Agent created!
agentCreated.body: It's getting itself set up right now. You can talk to it already.

sendMissionIntro.title: Give it work
sendMissionIntro.body: You ask in plain words, and your agent gets to it. I'll show you where.

sendMission.title: Click New task
sendMission.hint: That's how you give agents work
sendMission.typeHint: In your own words, then send
sendMission.emailHint: Its first task is already written
sendMission.sendHint: We wrote your agent's first task for you

missionSent.title: Task sent!
missionSent.body: Your agent is on it. That's the whole loop: you ask, it works.

createAgentDialog.nameTitle: Pick a color and give it a name.

emailSent.title: Check your inbox!
emailSent.body: Your agent just sent you a real email. That's it working for you, for real.

name.title: Name your workspace
name.description: Workspaces keep your agents organized, one for personal, one for work, etc.

provider.title: Connect your AI
provider.description: Houston uses <emph>your own</emph> subscription. We never see your credentials.

migrationReconnect.title: Welcome back
migrationReconnect.body: Your assistants and everything you've worked on are right here. Just reconnect your AI to pick up where you left off.
migrationReconnect.dismissError: We couldn't save that. Please try again.

industry.title: What industry do you work in?
industry.subtitle: So Houston understands the world you work in.

goal.title: What would you love to automate?
goal.subtitle: Describe one task you would happily hand off.
goal.placeholder: For example, go through my inbox every morning and draft replies to anything urgent.
goal.tooLong: That is a bit long. Please keep it under {{max}} characters.

completion.title: Help us tailor Houston to you
completion.subtitle: A couple of quick questions so Houston fits the way you work.

onboardingSurvey.otherPlaceholder: Tell us in a few words

errors.setupFailed: We couldn't finish setting up your workspace. Please try again.
errors.title: Setup didn't finish
errors.body: Something went wrong while creating your assistant. Try again, or go back and pick a different AI.

defaults.focus: Help me stay organized, prepare my day, draft messages, protect focus time, and keep track of follow-ups.
defaults.approvalRule: Ask before sending messages, creating calendar events, or changing anything in connected apps.

meetingPrep.name: Meeting prep
meetingPrep.description: Pull together everything you need before your next meeting: who is on the call, what you last discussed, and anything time-sensitive, from your inbox and a quick web check, handed to you before it starts.

connect.title: Connect your AI
connect.body: Choose the AI you already pay for and sign in. You bring your own subscription, so Houston never sees your password or your bill.

email.title: See your agent in action
email.body: Your agent will send a real email to you, so you can watch it work.
email.skipHint: Something went wrong? You can continue in Houston and try again later.

aiConnected.title: Your AI is connected!
aiConnected.body: Your agent can think now. You're one step closer.

connectEmail.title: Give your agent access to your email
connectEmail.body: Pick your email so your agent can send on your behalf. You connect it once, securely.

emailConnected.title: Email connected!
emailConnected.body: That's how easy connecting an app is, and your agent can reach 1000+ this way.

finished.title: Check your inbox!
finished.body: Your Personal Assistant just proved it can act for you, for real.
finished.readyBody: Your Personal Assistant is ready to get to work for you.
finished.inviteTeamBody: See who's working on every task. Create a team and share your agents.
